messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need header-based feature gating in the JS SDK for the new streaming_v2 toggle. Plan is canary 20% of v2 clients, then 100% after metrics look good.

sam: which header are we using? and how will server decide if client is eligible?

maya: header we agreed: `X-RW-Features: streaming_v2=on` plus `X-RW-Client-Version` so server can do version-scoped audience checks. example:```
X-RW-Client-Version: 2.4.0
X-RW-Features: streaming_v2=on
```

jordan: for older SDKs that don't send the header, what's the default? fall back to off?

maya: yes default = off. Server-side flag evaluation treats missing header as not opted-in. We will also gate evaluation to client version >= 2.4.0 to avoid unexpected behavior.

li: SDK change: send header only when feature is explicitly enabled in config, not automatically. Also add a safe parsing routine for feature header (ignore unknown keys). I'll add tests.

sam: rollout audience — do we do percentage buckets across all clients or only v2 clients?

maya: only v2 (client-version >=2.4.0). Console flag: audience = "20% of users where client_version >= 2.4.0". We'll record metric tag `rollout.bucket` for analysis.

jordan: what metrics/alerts do we watch during canary? error rate, stream disconnects, token loss, latency tail (p99), and cost per token. Can we get dashboards?

maya: ops to create temporary dashboard: p99 latency, stream disconnects, error 5xx rate, user-visible regressions (rate of empty/chopped responses). set alert: error rate spike >3x baseline for 10m.

opsbot: @maya created dashboard `canary/streaming_v2/1769994321` and set alert rule `streaming_v2:error_spike`. Link: https://console.redwood/dashboard/canary/streaming_v2/1769994321

sam: do we need a compatibility shim in SDK so older app code doesn't break when header is present?

li: header is opt-in only; adding it won't change payload shape. But we will also bump user-agent string to include `rw-sdk/2.4.0`. That should help server-side matching.

maya: rollout steps (short):
1) PR in sdk-js to add header and UA bump (Li) -> include unit tests + integration where header emitted.
2) Feature flag in Console: `sdk.streaming_v2` with audience rule version>=2.4.0, 20% bucket (maya).
3) Canary infra: create dashboard + alert (opsbot done).
4) Smoke run: internal beta + 10 customers (sam).
5) Promote to 100% after 24h stable.

dev-bot: checklist triggered: `sdk-js#823` created by li. CI status: running.

sam: i'll schedule the 10-customer list and coordinate comms with CS.

jordan: quick ask on server: if the feature header arrives but flag eval says off, do we still log header for telemetry?

maya: yes log header as telemetry field but strip sensitive values. We only log feature keys (names) and client version. No granularity beyond that.

li: PR ready for review, small diff. I'll add a fallback test: simulate older clients missing header.

maya: reviewers: @sam @jordan please skim before EOD. If you approve, i'll flip the console flag to 20% tomorrow morning.

sam: on it. :thumbsup:

jordan: will review after stand.

maya: also make sure rollback plan: console flag -> 0% and SDK can disable header immediately via remote config if we see issues.

li: noted. adding a quick toggle in SDK config `features.headersEnabled = false` so we can disable without deploy.

maya: perfect. thanks everyone. will post short exec-summary in #eng-release when canary starts.

sam: thanks — appreciate the clear checklist.

dev-bot: CI passed for `sdk-js#823`.
